UDKGame.ini.info: Primary Renegade X game settings. Edit this INI for server identity, player limits, and GameSpecificMapCycles map voting/rotation. The launcher mirrors this file into persistent config before startup.
UDKGame.ini.content:
[Engine.GameInfo]
DefaultGameType=RenX_Game.Rx_Game
DefaultGame=RenX_Game.Rx_Game
DefaultServerGame=RenX_Game.Rx_Game
PlayerControllerClassName=RenX_Game.Rx_Controller
MaxPlayers={gameserver.slot_limit}
MaxSpectators=2
GameDifficulty=+1.0
bAdminCanPause=false

[Engine.GameReplicationInfo]
ServerName={gameserver.list_name}
MessageOfTheDay=

[Engine.AccessControl]
AdminPassword={gameserver.rcon_password}
GamePassword=
IPPolicies=ACCEPT;*

[UTGame.UTGame]
bForceRespawn=true
bPlayersMustBeReady=false
NetWait=15
MinNetPlayers=1
bWaitForNetPlayers=false
RestartWait=30
ClientProcessingTimeout=30
GameSpecificMapCycles=(GameClassName="Rx_Game",Maps=("CNC-Field","CNC-Walls","CNC-GoldRush","CNC-Whiteout","CNC-Islands","CNC-LakeSide","CNC-Mesa","CNC-Volcano","CNC-Canyon","CNC-Complex","CNC-Under","CNC-Oasis","CNC-Xmountain"))
GameSpecificMapCycles=(GameClassName="Rx_Game_Survival",Maps=("DEF-DarkNight","DEF-HillSide"))

UDKEngine.ini.info: Network, Steam/query, starting map, and custom-content download settings. The launcher mirrors this file into persistent config before startup.
UDKEngine.ini.content:
[URL]
MapExt=udk
Map=RenX-MenuMap.udk
LocalMap=CNC-Field.udk
Port={gameserver.game_port}
PeerPort={gameserver.raw_port}

[IpDrv.TcpNetDriver]
AllowDownloads=true
MaxClientRate=15000
MaxInternetClientRate=10000
NetServerMaxTickRate=30

[IpDrv.HTTPDownload]
ConnectionTimeout=30
RedirectToURL=https://community-content.totemarts.services/
UseCompression=false

[OnlineSubsystemSteamworks.OnlineSubsystemSteamworks]
bEnableSteam=true
QueryPort={gameserver.query_port}
bUseVAC=false
Region=255
ServerBrowserTimeout=10
